flags.title: Case-specific notice facts unverified
flags.detail: Keep unit cells blank; do not infer eligibility, base rent, anniversary, license, lease permission, banking, petition, subsidy, repair/retaliation or service facts.

flags.title: License timing is effective-date based
flags.detail: Rule 13.14 uses the effective date, not service date; confirming license before service is conservative practice only.

flags.title: Banking summary wording differs
flags.detail: SF guidance says 24 full months; Rule 4.12 says a full 12 months from when an increase could have been imposed. Require full history; no case banking inferred.

flags.title: Notice-nullity wording differs
flags.detail: Include full §37.3(b) breakdown and Rule 4.12 banked dates conservatively; do not rely on limited exceptions without review.

flags.title: Form 583 / annual template not verified as annual-notice filing duty
flags.detail: Form 583 is described for case documents; keep private service record; no mandatory annual-notice template verified in reviewed Forms Center sections.

flags.title: Official examples contain date/rate inconsistencies
flags.detail: Use operative Current Rates/Form 571 schedule and statute/rules, not inconsistent examples.

flags.title: Fixed-term mid-term permission unknown
flags.detail: DRE guide verifies general rule; actual lease clause/end date blank and flagged.

flags.title: No attorney approval or challenge immunity
flags.detail: Conservative checklist capable of tenant-lawyer review only; neutral wording is not a retaliation/discrimination safe harbor.

rows.label: Coverage gate
rows.rule: Many pre-June 14, 1979 units covered; exemptions exist; check PIM.

rows.label: Housing Inventory gate
rows.rule: All residential owners report; tenant-occupied covered units receive license; March 1 annual update.

rows.label: License effective-date gate
rows.rule: Rule 13.14 null/void if unlicensed on effective date; effective date not service date controls.

rows.label: Lease term gate
rows.rule: Fixed-term mid-term increase only if agreement expressly allows; actual lease unknown.

rows.label: Lawful base rent gate
rows.rule: Calculate on base rent; exclude temporary passthroughs; owner rent not verified lawful base.

rows.label: Anniversary gate
rows.rule: Rule 1.11 anniversary is date current rent became effective; next increase >=1 year; later increase resets.

rows.label: Rate gate
rows.rule: 1.6% effective 3/1/26-2/28/27; use rate on effective date.

rows.label: Banking gate
rows.rule: SF 24-month summary vs Rule 4.12 12-month formulation; no case banking inferred.

rows.label: Petition/passthrough gate
rows.rule: Annual/banked no petition; other routes have pre-notice filing rules.

rows.label: Subsidy gate
rows.rule: Tenant-based assistance may add notice requirements; status unknown.

rows.label: Repair/retaliation gate
rows.rule: Civil Code 1942.5 restrictions; neutral policy not safe harbor.

rows.label: Occupant-change gate
rows.rule: No extra rent merely for added occupant; 6.14/Costa-Hawkins facts not inferred.

rows.label: Written notice
rows.rule: Civil Code 827 written notice; SF dollar/percentage/effective date.

rows.label: Current/new base rent
rows.rule: State verified current and new base rent.

rows.label: Dollar/percentage
rows.rule: State dollar increase and percentage.

rows.label: Effective date
rows.rule: State effective date; rate and anniversary apply.

rows.label: Annual/banked breakdown

rows.label: Banked dates
rows.rule: Rule 4.12(b)(2) dates; include conservatively despite nullity wording differences.

rows.label: Other components
rows.rule: Identify/explain O&M, comps, capital, utility, bond, RAP components if any.

rows.label: Notice period
rows.rule: 30 days <=10%; 90 days >10% combined; CA mail +5; longer periods control.

rows.label: No rounding up
rows.rule: Base rent x allowed percentage; no rounding up.

rows.label: Neutral reason
rows.rule: Neutral annual-increase statement is drafting practice, not statutory reason requirement or safe harbor.
